requisito: Counts how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u, both lowercase and uppercase) appear in a string.

difetti.indizio: Look at the if condition inside the foreach loop.
difetti.spiegazione: The comparison only checks lowercase vowels without normalizing the character with char.ToLowerInvariant, so it skips uppercase letters like 'A'.

difetti.indizio: Look at the for loop condition.
difetti.spiegazione: The condition i < testo.Length - 1 stops one character before the end of the string, always skipping the last character.
